title: Right anodyne simplicial maps
statement: For simplicial sets, define a right anodyne map to be a morphism in the smallest morphism property containing every isomorphism and every horn inclusion $\Lambda_i^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$ for $n\geq1$ and $0<i\leq n$, and closed under pushouts, transfinite compositions and retracts.

source.place: Kerodon Variant 4.2.4.2 and Proposition 4.3.6.4: right anodyne extensions are generated by right horns and isomorphisms under pushouts, transfinite compositions and retracts.
